Summary / sales notes:
- Mid-market SaaS: B2B developer tools (integrations, CI helpers). Product team evaluating LLM assistant to surface docs + code snippets and to power support triage.
- Initial interest: start on Hosted API to iterate product UX, then move to Dedicated (VPC) for predictable throughput and data isolation.
- POC: hosted API prototype running with 3 internal apps (code-assistant bot, doc search embeddings, support reranker). Customer measuring latency and token cost.
- Security: primary concern. Security lead (CTO-level) requires SOC2 Type II, SAML SSO integration, centralized audit logs, KMS-managed keys, and retention controls (30/90/365 day options). Also asked about ability to restrict model variants and enforce routing to private model pool.
- Quote from CTO: "We need to be confident we can prove controls before committing to Dedicated — SOC2 artifacts and a clear SAML plan are non-negotiable."
- Technical notes: saw sporadic 99p latency spikes during burst tests (seq len ~512). SE suspects batching policy and KV cache mis-hit. Suggested Optimize recommendations: aggressive prefix caching for doc-search, quantization profile for cost/test baseline.
- Commercial: Interested in 12–24 month committed Dedicated at predictable throughput. Wants sample TCO comparison: Hosted vs Dedicated w/ reserved GPU pool.
- Next actions: send vendor SOC2 upload link, provide SAML test metadata (IdP/SP), deliver Dedicated sizing & pricing spreadsheet, schedule SRE call for VPC peering details.
